purpose: Prove that future validation runs can retain the locality/time-resolved latent, belief, support, lifecycle, and recorded layers required for construct validation without changing model dynamics.

truth: seven-dimensional control for every locality/actor vector
formation locality, microzone, personnel, availability, readiness, command, moving/effectiveness state
actor_information: observer-target-locality control beliefs with confidence and update time
presence beliefs with personnel/presence estimates and confidence
action_support: local fighter equivalents split into fielded/unfielded
battle, nonfielded-human-target, asset, and coercion support booleans/quantities
record_layer: latent synthetic record identity and recorded flag

scientific_firewall: The observer is study-layer instrumentation only and may not modify transition equations, scheduler order, RNG streams, or recording probabilities.
An instrumented run must end in the same deterministic retained-state fingerprint as an otherwise identical uninstrumented run.
Historical Nepal is not rerun to repair its missing retention; the limitation is preserved.
Afghanistan's active historical confrontation is not modified or interrupted.
acceptance_gate: all required daily layers structurally present
event-boundary lifecycle detector passes birth/change/removal unit recovery
instrumented and baseline final retained-state fingerprints are identical for every seed
interpretation: A pass validates prospective measurement retention architecture only. It does not repair Nepal construct validity, establish historical fit, or authorize parameter/core changes.
